lines.zh: 我太高太窄，风一吹就晃。
lines.en: I am too tall and narrow; the wind rocks me.

lines.zh: 我站着有两格多，走起来像根杆子。
lines.en: I stand over two blocks tall and walk like a pole.

lines.zh: 我侧身走，省得被风推倒。
lines.en: I walk sideways so the wind cannot push me over.

lines.zh: 沙面上只留一条细长的痕。
lines.en: Only one thin, long trace remains on the sand.

lines.zh: 我的脚没入沙里，膝盖却很僵。
lines.en: My feet sink in the sand, but my knees stay stiff.

lines.zh: 异位的路很宽，我却走得很直。
lines.en: Dustopia's roads are wide; still I walk them straight.

lines.zh: 我不绕石头，我跨过去。
lines.en: I do not go around stones; I step over them.

lines.zh: 细长的身子有个好处，钻缝容易。
lines.en: A narrow body has one use: slipping through gaps.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我都听见自己在响。
lines.en: Every step, I hear myself creak.

lines.zh: 沙暴来了，我背对着走。
lines.en: When the sandstorm comes, I walk with my back to it.

lines.zh: 别走在我旁边，我怕撞到你。
lines.en: Do not walk beside me; I might knock into you.

lines.zh: 我往那片灰里走，那边有人味。
lines.en: I walk into that grey, where the smell of people is.

lines.zh: 我站着，就像插在沙里的一根桩。
lines.en: Standing, I am a post driven into the sand.

lines.zh: 风从我的肋骨间穿过去，很凉。
lines.en: Wind passes between my ribs, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 我不弯，弯下去就起不来了。
lines.en: I do not bend; bent, I could not rise.

lines.zh: 沙落在我肩上，堆成薄薄一层。
lines.en: Sand settles on my shoulders in a thin layer.

lines.zh: 我大半个身子都露在风里。
lines.en: Most of my body stands exposed to the wind.

lines.zh: 安静时，我听见自己内部在塌。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear my insides settling.

lines.zh: 这片空地没有遮挡，我喜欢。
lines.en: This open flat has no cover, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我数风的方向，一共变了四次。
lines.en: I count the wind's turns; it has changed four times.

lines.zh: 手臂垂着，比抬起来省力。
lines.en: Letting my arms hang costs less than lifting them.

lines.zh: 我不坐下，坐下就露短了。
lines.en: I do not sit; sitting shows how short I am.

lines.zh: 你比我矮一个头，我不用抬头。
lines.en: You are a head shorter; I need not look up.

lines.zh: 我两格多高，得弯腰才看得清你。
lines.en: I stand over two blocks tall; I have to bend to see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你的肩很宽，我钻不过去。
lines.en: Your shoulders are wide; I cannot slip past.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，隔着沙我也感到。
lines.en: I feel your body's heat even through the sand.

lines.zh: 我一直在算，你离我几臂。
lines.en: I keep measuring how many arms you stand away.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，脖子一定酸。
lines.en: Looking up at me must strain your neck.

lines.zh: 我看你，像在看一道缝。
lines.en: I look at you the way I look at a gap.

lines.zh: 你在风里眨眼，我数到三。
lines.en: You blink in the wind; I counted three.

lines.zh: 我不会眨眼，所以你先眨眼。
lines.en: I do not blink, so you will blink first.

lines.zh: 你的影子太短，我找不准你。
lines.en: Your shadow is too short; I cannot place you.

lines.zh: 你打在我肋上，声音空空的。
lines.en: You hit my ribs, and the sound was hollow.

lines.zh: 我弯了一下，又直回来。
lines.en: I bent once and straightened again.

lines.zh: 伤口在漏沙，漏得很慢。
lines.en: The wound leaks sand, very slowly.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍断了我半截手指。
lines.en: That blade took half a finger.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫会散掉气。
lines.en: I do not cry out; crying would scatter my breath.

lines.zh: 疼在高处，离脚很远。
lines.en: The pain is high up, far from my feet.

lines.zh: 你砍得准，可我很薄。
lines.en: Your cut was true, but I am thin.

lines.zh: 我歪了，得扶住自己。
lines.en: I am tilting and must hold myself up.

lines.zh: 一百一十一颗心，还早。
lines.en: A hundred and eleven hearts; it is still early.

lines.zh: 沙从我身上淌下来，像水。
lines.en: Sand runs off me like water.

lines.zh: 你举什么我都不要，我只想靠近。
lines.en: Whatever you raise, I do not want it; I only want closer.

lines.zh: 面包在异位会立刻变干。
lines.en: Bread dries out instantly in Dustopia.

lines.zh: 我只想缩短这段距离，别的不吃。
lines.en: I want only to shorten this distance.

lines.zh: 你把食物放在地上，我就踩过去。
lines.en: Set the food down and I will walk over it.

lines.zh: 别用声音引我，我听见你心跳。
lines.en: Do not lure me with noise; I hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，只想咬住什么。
lines.en: Mouth open, I only want to bite something.

lines.zh: 食物的味道太淡，血才清楚。
lines.en: Food smells too faint; blood is clearer.

lines.zh: 你退三步，我就当你让开。
lines.en: Step back three paces and I will count it as yielding.

lines.zh: 诱惑这种东西，对沙没用。
lines.en: Temptation does nothing to sand.

lines.zh: 你把东西收好，省得我踩碎。
lines.en: Put it away before I tread on it.

lines.zh: 我一撞就歪，得扶一下墙。
lines.en: One knock and I tilt; I need a wall.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腰上，正好是最细处。
lines.en: You hit my waist, the thinnest part of me.

lines.zh: 我太窄，你很容易把我顶偏。
lines.en: I am so narrow that you easily push me aside.

lines.zh: 我们擦过去，沙掉了一地。
lines.en: We brush past and sand falls all around.

lines.zh: 别从侧面来，我会折。
lines.en: Do not come from the side; I would fold.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，你要退半步。
lines.en: One bump from me and you step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 碰上的时候，我听见你的铁甲响。
lines.en: At contact I heard your iron plates ring.

lines.zh: 我让开一半，剩下的路你挤。
lines.en: I yield half; squeeze past the rest.

lines.zh: 两副身子撞一起，只有灰落下。
lines.en: Two bodies collide and only dust comes down.

lines.zh: 你推我，我就顺势贴近。
lines.en: Push me and I lean in with the push.

lines.zh: 异位里没有第二个这么高的。
lines.en: There is no second one this tall in Dustopia.

lines.zh: 我这样的身子，配对会折断。
lines.en: A body like mine would snap in pairing.

lines.zh: 沙里没有幼崽，只有更多的沙。
lines.en: No young in this sand, only more sand.

lines.zh: 我找过同伴，影子倒是有几个。
lines.en: I looked for company; I found several shadows.

lines.zh: 两个高个子撞在一起，会塌。
lines.en: Two tall ones meeting would collapse.

lines.zh: 我不孤单，我只是很长。
lines.en: I am not lonely; I am merely long.

lines.zh: 同类的声音，像两根杆子互敲。
lines.en: My kind's voice is two poles knocking.

lines.zh: 你问得太近了，退一步。
lines.en: You ask too close; take a step back.

lines.zh: 这地方容不下成双的东西。
lines.en: This place has no room for things in pairs.

lines.zh: 我的影子够长，能陪我站着。
lines.en: My shadow is long enough to stand with me.

lines.zh: 弯腰捡东西，我得先蹲下。
lines.en: To pick something up, I must first crouch.

lines.zh: 地上这块铁，我夹在指间。
lines.en: I pinch the iron off the ground between two fingers.

lines.zh: 太小的东西，我的指头捏不住。
lines.en: My fingers cannot hold anything this small.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块骨，又轻轻放回。
lines.en: I lift a bone and set it gently back.

lines.zh: 这截断铁在我指间细得像根针。
lines.en: This broken iron looks thin as a needle between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，捡起来只为看看。
lines.en: I collect nothing; I pick things up to look.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西我够得到，还你。
lines.en: I can reach what you dropped; take it back.

lines.zh: 沙里翻出的碎玻璃，扎手。
lines.en: Shards of glass in the sand prick my fingers.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，走了两步就扔了。
lines.en: I carried it two steps and dropped it.

lines.zh: 这么轻的东西，风一吹就没。
lines.en: Something this light is gone with one gust.

lines.zh: 你走进这片灰，我就开始走了。
lines.en: You entered the grey, and I began walking.

lines.zh: 我比看上去快，别信我的腿。
lines.en: I am faster than I look; do not trust my legs.

lines.zh: 一百一十一颗心的身子，不怕你。
lines.en: A body of a hundred and eleven hearts does not fear you.

lines.zh: 我一击十二点，你要算清楚。
lines.en: One blow of mine is twelve; count carefully.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道送到我脸上。
lines.en: The wind brings your smell up to my face.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，我只要一步步来。
lines.en: I need not run; I only need to keep coming.

lines.zh: 你退到沙丘后，我也看得见。
lines.en: Even behind the dune, I can see you.

lines.zh: 目标定下，我的脖子就不转了。
lines.en: Once fixed, my neck no longer turns.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西挡不住我。
lines.en: What you hold will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，压过你的脚印。
lines.en: Step by step, I trample your footprints.

lines.zh: 异位的猎手都很耐心。
lines.en: Dustopia's hunters are all patient.

lines.zh: 我要的不是食物，是你的位置。
lines.en: I want not food, but the place where you stand.

lines.zh: 你在动，我的影子也跟着动。
lines.en: You move, and my shadow moves with you.

lines.zh: 站住，让我看看你有多高。
lines.en: Stand still and let me see how tall you are.

lines.zh: 灰里多了一双脚印，不是我的。
lines.en: There's a new pair of prints in the ash. Not mine.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在雾灰里，比你先看见。
lines.en: In this dust haze, my eyes find you first.

lines.zh: 我跨一步，你跑三步。
lines.en: I take one stride; you take three.

lines.zh: 你藏在石头后，正好露出肩。
lines.en: Behind that rock, your shoulder shows.

lines.zh: 异位的风把我的影子拉长。
lines.en: The wind of the Elsewhere stretches my shadow.

lines.zh: 距离还有八臂，我在数。
lines.en: Eight arms of distance left, and I am counting.

lines.zh: 你越跑越慢，沙拖住你的脚。
lines.en: You slow down; the sand holds your feet.

lines.zh: 我不用绕，我直接跨过沟。
lines.en: I do not go around; I step over the ditch.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸已经乱了，听得出来。
lines.en: Your breath is already uneven; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖比甲片软。
lines.en: Your knees are softer than plate.

lines.zh: 再往那边是悬崖，你选吧。
lines.en: Farther that way is a cliff; choose.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊会浪费气。
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting wastes breath.

lines.zh: 你回头看了两次，我都记着。
lines.en: You looked back twice, and I remember both.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经盖到你的脚。
lines.en: My shadow has reached your feet.

lines.zh: 跑动的东西，最后都会停。
lines.en: Everything that runs stops eventually.

lines.zh: 还差三步，你不用再算了。
lines.en: Three steps left; you need not count anymore.

lines.zh: 我走一步，灰就扬一层。
lines.en: Each step I take lifts another layer of ash.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经贴在我脚边了。
lines.en: Your shadow already touches my feet.

lines.zh: 我不急，异位的夜很长。
lines.en: No rush. Nights in the Otherside are long.

lines.zh: 你往后看，后面也是灰。
lines.en: Look back. It's only ash behind you.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候，你先眨眼。
lines.en: When I raise my hand, you blink first.

lines.zh: 这一段路，我陪你走完。
lines.en: I'll walk this stretch to its end with you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，风就跟着落下来。
lines.en: I raise my arm and the wind falls with it.

lines.zh: 这一击，从很高的地方来。
lines.en: This blow comes from very high up.

lines.zh: 你的头盔凹了一块，我听见了。
lines.en: Your helmet dented, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 十二点，一下就够了。
lines.en: Twelve points, and one hit is enough.

lines.zh: 我不挥，我只是让手臂落下。
lines.en: I do not swing; I simply let my arm fall.

lines.zh: 你挡上面，我就打下面。
lines.en: You guard high, so I strike low.

lines.zh: 这具身子太细，力气却都在。
lines.en: This frame is thin, yet all the force is there.

lines.zh: 你退一步，异位的土就进两步。
lines.en: One step back, and the wasteland takes two.

lines.zh: 沙被我踩得飞扬，你看不清了。
lines.en: My step kicks up sand; you cannot see clearly.

lines.zh: 我打偏了一次，不会第二次。
lines.en: I missed once; I will not miss twice.

lines.zh: 你的盾角度不对，我知道。
lines.en: Your shield's angle is wrong, and I know it.

lines.zh: 这一下让你跪了，很好。
lines.en: That one brought you to your knees; good.

lines.zh: 我打得慢，落得重。
lines.en: I strike slowly and land heavily.

lines.zh: 抬头，我要打你的脸。
lines.en: Look up; I am striking your face.

lines.zh: 我落手的地方，沙陷下去。
lines.en: Where my hand lands, the sand sinks.

lines.zh: 你的胸甲裂了，听声音就知道。
lines.en: Your chestplate split. I heard it.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着整片荒原的力气。
lines.en: This fist carries the whole wasteland's weight.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我一步就追平。
lines.en: You retreat two steps; one step makes it even.

lines.zh: 我的指头很长，够到你身后。
lines.en: My fingers are long enough to reach behind you.

lines.zh: 你跪下去，灰正好没过膝。
lines.en: You kneel, and the ash reaches your knees.

lines.zh: 风把一根沙柱吹直，那就是我。
lines.en: The wind straightened a pillar of sand, and that was me.

lines.zh: 我从地里长出来，很慢。
lines.en: I grew out of the ground, very slowly.

lines.zh: 两格多高，站直了才像样。
lines.en: Over two blocks tall; I only look right standing straight.

lines.zh: 又一个细长的影子落在沙上。
lines.en: Another long thin shadow falls on the sand.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，尘土先落。
lines.en: When I appear, the dust settles first.

lines.zh: 这片灰地该有人走了。
lines.en: Someone should walk this grey land.

lines.zh: 我的骨头是沙压成的。
lines.en: My bones are pressed from sand.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，风正好停了。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, the wind had just stopped.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我刚站起来，站不稳。
lines.en: Do not come close; I just stood and I am unsteady.

lines.zh: 我来了，从沙丘的背阴处。
lines.en: I come from the shadowed side of the dune.

lines.zh: 高高的一根，就是我。
lines.en: A tall thin pillar; that is me.

lines.zh: 异位又添了一个猎手。
lines.en: Dustopia has gained another hunter.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我细长的身子就弯了。
lines.en: Fire bends my long thin frame.

lines.zh: 我从两格多高摔下，散了一半。
lines.en: I fell from two blocks up and half of me scattered.

lines.zh: 水漫到腰，我的沙开始沉。
lines.en: Water reaches my waist and my sand starts to sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我折成两截。
lines.en: The blast folds me in two.

lines.zh: 异位维度的风灌进这洞里。
lines.en: The wind of the Abyss pours into that hole.

lines.zh: 药水洒在我身上，沙结了硬块。
lines.en: Potion spilled on me and my sand hardened into lumps.

lines.zh: 没有东西可吃，我只会变轻。
lines.en: Nothing to eat; I will only grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打在头上，我短了一截。
lines.en: Lightning hit my head and I lost a length.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有立足的地方。
lines.en: The void gives nowhere to plant my feet.
